body.message:
Yes, we do A to A. For a 2BR in Business Bay, we have Aykon City at AED 11,500/month, well within budget. There's also MAG 318 at AED 15,000/month if they want to stretch a little.

On the 6-month stay: we lock in the rate for the first 3 months, then reconfirm for the next 3 based on market at that point. Payment is first and last month upfront, rest monthly.

Which of the two would your client prefer to take a closer look at?
